title: RBB Senior Assistant (IT) — Level 5
title_nepali: राष्ट्रिय वाणिज्य बैंक — वरिष्ठ सहायक (सूचना प्रविधि) तह ५
description: Complete 20-year past question bank (2,000+ Q&As: 837 MCQs & 1,174 Subjective Model Q&As) covering Paper I (Banking & Management + IT MCQs) and Paper II (Technical Subjects).
exam_scheme: Paper I — Section A: Banking & Management Subjective (50 Marks | 1 hr 15 min)
Paper I — Section B: Information Technology Objective (50 MCQs × 1M = 50 Marks | 45 min)
Paper II — Section A: Computer Systems, Architecture & Networking Subjective (50 Marks)
Paper II — Section B: OS, DBMS, DRP & Cybersecurity Subjective (50 Marks | 2 hr 30 min total)
Stage II — Oral Interview (30 Marks)

syllabus_sections.title: Paper I — Section A: Banking, Management & Acts (50 Marks)
topics: Unit 1: Nepalese Banking & Financial System, NRB, Commercial Banks
Unit 2: NRB Act 2058, Monetary Policy, Inflation & Liquidity
Unit 3: BAFIA 2073, AML/CFT Act 2064, Banking Offence Act 2064
Unit 4: Organizational Management, HRM, Leadership & Motivation
Unit 5: Accounting Principles, Financial Statements & Ratios
Unit 6: Trade, Remittance, Foreign Exchange & Economic Indicators

syllabus_sections.title: Paper I (Sec B - 50 MCQs) & Paper II (Sec A & B - 100 Marks): Information Technology
topics: Unit 1: Computer Systems, Data Centre Security, AI/ML & Blockchain
Unit 2: Computer Architecture, CPU Registers, Cache Memory & DMA
Unit 3: Computer Networking, OSI Model, Subnetting & Cryptography
Unit 4: Operating System, Process Scheduling, Deadlock & Virtual Memory
Unit 5: DBMS, Normalization, SQL, Data Warehousing & Disaster Recovery (DRP)
Unit 6: Cybersecurity Threats, IS Audit/VAPT, ETA 2063 & NRB IT Guidelines

title: Section Officer (Shakha Adhikrit) — Gazetted 3rd Class
title_nepali: शाखा अधिकृत (निजामती सेवा — राजपत्रांकित तृतीय श्रेणी)
description: Federal Civil Service Section Officer (Administration, Revenue, Foreign Affairs, Audit & Parliament) covering GK/IQ Prelims, Governance, Contemporary Issues, and Service-Related Subjects.
exam_scheme: Phase I (Preliminary): Paper I — Administrative Aptitude Test: GK (50M) + IQ (30M) + English (20M) = 100 MCQs (1 hr 30 min)
Phase II: Paper II — Governance Systems (शासन प्रणाली) Subjective (100 Marks | 3 hrs)
Phase II: Paper III — Contemporary Issues (समसामयिक विषय) Subjective (100 Marks | 3 hrs)
Phase II: Paper IV — Service-Related Subject (सेवा सम्बन्धी) Subjective (100 Marks | 3 hrs)
Phase III: IT Skill Test (10M) + Group Test (10M) + Interview (30M)

syllabus_sections.title: Paper I: GK, IQ & English (100 Marks Objective)
topics: Geography, History, Culture & Socio-Economic System of Nepal
Science, Technology, Environment & Sustainable Development
International Affairs, UN, SAARC, BIMSTEC & Current Affairs
Verbal, Numerical & Non-Verbal Reasoning (IQ) + English Comprehension

syllabus_sections.title: Paper II & III: Governance Systems & Contemporary Issues (200 Marks Subjective)
topics: Constitution of Nepal, Federalism, Fundamental Rights & Directive Principles
Public Administration, Public Policy, Bureaucracy & New Public Management (NPM)
Good Governance Act 2064, Civil Service Act 2049, Right to Information Act 2064
Social Justice, Inclusion, Climate Change, Economic Diplomacy & Development Planning

title: Nayab Subba (NaSu) — Non-Gazetted 1st Class
title_nepali: नायब सुब्बा (निजामती सेवा — राजपत्र अनंकित प्रथम श्रेणी)
description: Comprehensive preparation for Nayab Subba (General Administration, Revenue, Accounts, Judicial & Foreign Service) with GK/IQ MCQs and Second/Third Paper model answers.
exam_scheme: Stage I: Paper I — General Knowledge (30 MCQs × 2M) + IQ (20 MCQs × 2M) = 100 Marks (45 min)
Stage II: Paper II — Contemporary Studies & Public Service Management Subjective (100 Marks | 2 hr 30 min)
Stage II: Paper III — Service-Group Related Subject Subjective (100 Marks | 2 hr 30 min)
Stage III: Computer Skill Test (10 Marks) + Interview (30 Marks)

syllabus_sections.title: Paper I: General Knowledge & General Mental Ability Test (100 Marks)
topics: Geography, History, Economic Planning & Social Customs of Nepal
Constitution of Nepal, UNO, SAARC & Current Events
Verbal, Numerical & Figural Reasoning (IQ)

syllabus_sections.title: Paper II: Contemporary Studies & Public Service Management (100 Marks)
topics: Office Management, Record Management, Tippani, Chalani & Darta
Constitution of Nepal, Local Government Operation Act 2074
Public Service Charter, Corruption Control, E-Governance & Public Finance

title: Kharidar — Non-Gazetted 2nd Class
title_nepali: खरिदार (निजामती सेवा — राजपत्र अनंकित द्वितीय श्रेणी)
description: Entry-level Civil Service Kharidar exam preparation covering GK & Basic Office Skills (Paper I), Office Management & Constitution (Paper II), and Accounting/Mathematics/Administration (Paper III).
exam_scheme: Stage I: Paper I — General Knowledge & Basic Office Skills Test (50 MCQs × 2M = 100 Marks | 45 min)
Stage II: Paper II — Office Management, Constitution & Civic Awareness Subjective (100 Marks | 2 hr 30 min)
Stage II: Paper III — Job Knowledge & Mathematics Subjective (100 Marks | 2 hr 30 min)
Stage III: Computer Skill Test (10 Marks) + Interview (20 Marks)

syllabus_sections.title: Paper I & II: GK, Office Management & Constitution
topics: Nepal Geography, History, Religion, Culture & Current Affairs
Office Procedures: Filing, Indexing, Correspondence, Tippani & Record Keeping
Constitution of Nepal, Fundamental Rights & Civic Duties
Civil Service Act 2049, Good Governance & Public Service Delivery

title: Computer Operator — Technical Level 5
title_nepali: कम्प्युटर अपरेटर (राजपत्र अनंकित प्रथम श्रेणी / तह ५ प्राविधिक)
description: Targeted preparation for Lok Sewa Computer Operator & Data Entry Supervisor: 50 Objective MCQs (Computer Fundamentals, OS, MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, HTML, Networking & IT Policy) + Practical Guide.
exam_scheme: Stage I: Written Objective Test — 50 MCQs × 2 Marks = 100 Marks (45 min | 20% Negative Marking)
Stage II: Practical Computer Skill Test (50 Marks — Nepali/English Typing, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, HTML)
Stage II: Oral Interview (20 Marks)

syllabus_sections.title: Written Objective Syllabus (50 MCQs)
topics: 1. Computer Fundamentals & Number Systems (10 MCQs)
2. Operating System (Windows / DOS / Linux) (5 MCQs)
3. Word Processing (MS Word) (10 MCQs)
4. Electronic Spreadsheet (MS Excel Formulas & Functions) (10 MCQs)
5. Database Management System (MS Access & SQL) (5 MCQs)
6. Presentation System (MS PowerPoint) (3 MCQs)
7. Web Page Design (HTML / CSS) & Computer Networks (4 MCQs)
8. Electronic Transaction Act 2063 & ICT Policy of Nepal (3 MCQs)

title: Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) — Assistant Level 4
organization: Nepal Rastra Bank (Central Bank of Nepal)
description: Central Bank Assistant recruitment exam preparation: Pre-test (Banking, Economics, Accounting, Maths, Computer & GK MCQs) + Written Paper I & Paper II model answers.
exam_scheme: Stage I (Pre-Test): 50 MCQs × 2 Marks = 100 Marks (45 min | Pass Marks: 40)
Stage II: Paper I — Banking, Accounting & Mathematics Subjective (100 Marks | 3 hrs)
Stage II: Paper II — Economics, Management & Banking Laws Subjective (100 Marks | 3 hrs)
Stage III: Interview (30 Marks)

syllabus_sections.title: Stage I & II Core Topics
topics: NRB Act 2058, BAFIA 2073, Monetary Policy & Foreign Exchange Regulation
Central Banking Functions, Supervision, CAMELS Rating & Basel III
Macroeconomics, Inflation, Balance of Payments (BoP), Remittance & Fiscal Policy
Financial Accounting, Trial Balance, Profit/Loss Account, Balance Sheet & Ratios

title: ADBL Business Assistant — Level 4 & 5
title_nepali: कृषि विकास बैंक — व्यवसाय सहायक / वरिष्ठ शाखा प्रमुख (तह ४/५)
description: Complete banking, accounting, rural credit, management, and financial act preparation for Agricultural Development Bank Ltd. (ADBL) competitive exams.
exam_scheme: Paper I: Banking, Management & Accounting (60 Marks Subjective + 40 Marks Objective MCQs)
Paper II: Service Related — Financial Analysis, Rural Credit, Customer Service & Banking Laws (100 Marks)
Interview: 30 Marks

syllabus_sections.title: Core Syllabus Highlights
topics: ADBL Evolution, Rural & Microfinance Credit, Deprived Sector Lending
Cheque, Promissory Note, Letter of Credit (LC), Bank Guarantee & KYC/AML
Double Entry Accounting, Depreciation, Bank Reconciliation & Ratio Analysis

title: NEA / Nepal Telecom / EPF — Level 5 Assistant
title_nepali: नेपाल विद्युत प्राधिकरण / नेपाल टेलिकम / कर्मचारी सञ्चय कोष — तह ५
description: Public Enterprise (Sansthan) exam preparation covering Institutional Acts (NEA Act 2041, EPF Act 2019, Telecom Act 2053), Office Management, Public Procurement Act 2063, and GK/IQ.
exam_scheme: Paper I: General Knowledge, IQ & Institutional Regulations (50 Marks Objective + 50 Marks Subjective)
Paper II: Service / Technical / Administrative Subject Paper (100 Marks Subjective)
Interview: 30 Marks

syllabus_sections.title: Sansthan Core Syllabus
topics: Nepal Electricity Authority Act 2041, EPF Act 2019, Telecommunications Act 2053
Public Procurement Act 2063 & Regulation 2064 (Tender, Bidding, E-GP)
Financial Administration, Auditing, Inventory Control & Institutional Governance
